*In [[Republic of China|Taiwan]], [[President of the Republic of China|President]] [[Chen Shui-bian]] signs a law that allows [[referendum]]s to be held. The [[People's Republic of China]] condemns this. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/asia-pacific/3358655.stm]
*[[Occupation of Iraq]]: A [[car bomb]] detonates outside an upmarket [[Baghdad]] restaurant much favoured by foreign journalists, killing five New Year revelers. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/3359687.stm]
* The [[Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences]] mails nomination ballots in which it qualifies 254 [[film]]s released in [[2003 in film|2003]] as eligible for [[Academy Awards|Oscar]] consideration.
